facts.heading: Patricia Meadows
facts.text: A lifelong Greater Waco resident and graduate of Waco High School and McLennan Community College, Patricia began her real estate career in 2001. Her specializations are residential, senior residential, new home construction, farm and ranch, and commercial real estate.
